performance.scope: Single identical two-step cProfile requests; all three complete matrices match exactly. Only root/snapshot evaluation counters differ. This is not a broad benchmark.

browser.scope: Free-frame source feedback step, complete exported history and project save/restore.

parity.scope: Complete free-frame feedback time output from one actual offline UI request.

retained_limits: Dense complete rank matrix remains; geometry/motion/aerodynamic columns still use full stencils.
Force/moment feedback, custom equations, unknown constitutive laws and unsupported charts retain full calculations.
Single short profiling comparison does not establish broad ASWING-equivalent performance.
Native ASWING agreement and remaining full-scope functionality stay open.
